issue.standard_remedy: Route off-contract buying to contracted suppliers
issue.summary: 78% of category spend is off contract

plan.diagnosis: 78% of Aluminium extrusions spend ($14,824,644 of $19,060,869 total category spend) is occurring off-contract across 9 plants, representing high-severity maverick spend in a direct material category. This fragmentation indicates lack of category management governance and plant-level non-compliance with contracted suppliers, likely driven by decentralized procurement across multiple ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa).

remedy_steps.step: Conduct urgent cross-plant audit to identify all maverick suppliers and root causes (price, lead time, quality, or awareness gaps) for the $14,824,644 off-contract spend across 9 facilities
Negotiate expanded capacity and pricing with existing contracted suppliers to cover the additional $14,824,644 demand, targeting 10-15% volume leverage savings
Implement ERP controls across all systems to block or flag non-contracted aluminium extrusion suppliers and require approval workflow for exceptions above $10,000
Deploy plant-by-plant training and communication campaign on contracted suppliers, approval processes, and cost impact of maverick buying to all 9 facilities
Establish monthly category compliance dashboard tracking on-contract spend percentage by plant and ERP system with plant manager accountability

plan.expected_impact: Redirecting $14,824,644 maverick spend to contracted suppliers is expected to yield $1,482,464 to $2,223,696 in annual savings (10-15% leverage from volume consolidation).
kpis: On-contract spend percentage for Aluminium extrusions (target: 95% from current 22%)
Number of active aluminium extrusion suppliers by plant (target: reduce by 60%)
Maverick spend USD per month (target: <$500,000 from current $1,235,387)
Cost per kg aluminium extrusion delivered (track 10-15% reduction)
PO compliance rate through approved suppliers by ERP system
risks: Contracted suppliers may lack capacity to absorb $14,824,644 additional volume across 9 plants without lead time extensions
Plant resistance due to established relationships or perceived quality/delivery advantages with maverick suppliers
Multi-ERP environment complexity may delay or create gaps in system controls implementation
Supply disruption risk if transition from maverick suppliers is too abrupt without proper change management
Contracted supplier pricing may not be competitive for all specifications currently sourced off-contract
erp_actions: SAP: Set posting block in LFB1 (vendor company code data) for all non-contracted aluminium extrusion suppliers; create source list entries (ME01) for contracted suppliers only with blocking indicator for alternatives
Oracle EBS: Update approved supplier list (ASL) to restrict aluminium extrusion category to contracted vendors only; enable sourcing rules enforcement in purchasing options
Dynamics 365: Configure trade agreement price restrictions for contracted suppliers; set up procurement policy rules requiring approval workflow for off-contract aluminium purchases >$10,000
NetSuite: Update vendor records with category restrictions; implement custom approval routing for aluminium extrusions to flag non-contracted suppliers at requisition stage

Coupa: Create supplier enablement restricted to contracted vendors for aluminium extrusion commodity codes; enable policy-based requisition blocks with category manager approval requirement for exceptions
All systems: Standardize commodity code mapping for aluminium extrusions to enable consistent reporting and controls across ERP platforms
